qbrowser: select sys_pk, userid, username, notes from tuser where ifnull(sys_deleted,0)=1
qrestore: update tuser set sys_deleted=0, userid=sys_info, sys_info='restored' where sys_pk=@sys_pk
qforze: update tuser set sys_deleted=0, userid=concat('R',sys_pk) where sys_pk=@sys_pk
qdelete: delete from user_usergroup_ where users=@sys_pk; delete from uservar where fuser=@sys_pk; delete b from det_usr a left join sitem_det_usr b on b.ref_det_usr=a.sys_pk where a.ref_user=@sys_pk; delete from det_usr where ref_user=@sys_pk; delete from tuser where sys_pk=@sys_pk;
